title: 内角换重心接伸手
description: 油画中，浅内角的低位重心转移与短伸手连成从容一刻。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: Create an original oil-painting illustration of a fictional fully clothed adult combining a small weight transfer with a short hand reach inside a shallow bouldering corner. Positive footholds support a comfortable stance across both faces, and broad blue jugs allow the torso to turn naturally toward the next nearby hold. Keep the knees modestly bent and avoid any extreme split. Use a wide three-quarter composition including the whole adult, both wall planes, warm gym lights, and continuous thick crash mats. Visible ochre impasto, indigo shadows, and muted rust clothing create a peaceful original scene. The landing stays clear. No text, brands, jumping, or dangerous height.
